svg.title: UCP checkout session status (v2026-08-25), with the AP2 lock
svg.desc: State diagram: UCP checkout session status (v2026-08-25), with the AP2 lock. 6 states: incomplete, requires_escalation, ready_for_complete, complete_in_progress, completed, and canceled. Starts in incomplete. Ends in completed and canceled. 13 transitions. From incomplete to ready_for_complete when All information collected, no Action outstanding (PUT /checkout-sessions/ id (update_checkout)). From incomplete to requires_escalation when Business needs data its API cannot collect, or a policy needs buyer review (POST or PUT /checkout-sessions response). From requires_escalation to incomplete when Issue resolved through an update (PUT /checkout-sessions/ id ). From requires_escalation to completed when Buyer finishes on the business UI through continue_url (continue_url (browser), then GET /checkout-sessions/ id ). From ready_for_complete to completed when Complete Checkout succeeds synchronously (POST /checkout-sessions/ id /complete (complete_checkout)). From ready_for_complete to complete_in_progress when Complete Checkout accepted for asynchronous processing (POST /checkout-sessions/ id /complete). From ready_for_complete to incomplete when Complete returns a recoverable change (for example payment_failed or out_of_stock) (POST /checkout-sessions/ id /complete). From ready_for_complete to requires_escalation when Complete returns a buyer handoff (requires_buyer_input or requires_buyer_review) (POST /checkout-sessions/ id /complete). From complete_in_progress to completed when Business finishes processing any Action resolved (GET /checkout-sessions/ id (get_checkout)). From incomplete to canceled when Platform cancels, or the session expires (POST /checkout-sessions/ id /cancel (cancel_checkout)). From requires_escalation to canceled when Platform cancels, or the session expires (POST /checkout-sessions/ id /cancel). From ready_for_complete to canceled when Platform cancels, or the session expires (POST /checkout-sessions/ id /cancel). From complete_in_progress to canceled when Session invalid or expired (cancellation race rules apply) (POST /checkout-sessions/ id /cancel).
